newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo RTB Bor 7-mth copper output 19 pct up yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Yugo RTB Bor 7-mth copper output 19 pct up yr/yr.

text.p: Yugoslav copper and smelting complex Rudarsko Topionicarski Basen Bor (RTB Bor) increased its copper output by 19 percent in January-July over the same period in 1996, Belgrade daily Borba wrote on Wednesday.

"RTB Bor complex produced 63,330 tonnes of cathode copper from January to the end of July, of which 33,201 tonnes from its own raw materials," the paper quoted deputy production director Zivorad Stanisavljevic as saying.
"This is a 19 percent production increase on the same period last year," he said.

"Production results prove that 1997 business policy targets -- stabilisation and production growth in all our enterprises along with radical cuts in production costs -- have been successfully accomplished."
RTB Bor groups 20 enterprises employing more than 20,000 people.
Besides productivity growth, investments and geological exploration are also the company's priority goals.
RTB Bor continued work on deepening and construction of new mininig premises in Jama pit and intensified construction of a 2.7 km transport system from Veliki Krivelj to Bor.
"We are also preparing reconstruction and modernisation of metallurgy capacities to cut production costs and reduce air pollution in Bor," Stanisavljevic said.
RTB Bor has also invested in purchase of new mining machinery, priority being heavy trucks for revitalisation of the southern surface copper mine Rudnik bakra Majdanpek.
The company has signed a $3.24 million credit deal with Volvo Euclid of the United States for the purchase of equipment in June.

RTB Bor said earlier its 1997 plans were to invest $40 million of its own funds in reconstructing production capacities raising copper in concentrate output to nearly 80,000 tonnes and cathode copper production to nearly 140,000 tonnes.
Total exports of the Bor complex this year are expected to reach $190 million, of which some $93 million would be net hard currency earnings.
In 1996, RTB Bor produced 104,500 tonnes of cathode copper. -- Gordana Kukic, Belgrade Newsroom 381 11 311 4254
